name: savepoint
description: A fast, lightweight desktop app to keep YouTube video and audio offline.

scripts.dist: npm run assets && npm run prepare:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.generated.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:dir: npm run assets && npm run prepare:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.generated.yml --win nsis --dir
scripts.release: npm run assets && npm run prepare:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.generated.yml --win nsis --publish always
scripts.release:ci: npm run assets && node scripts/set-version.mjs && npm run prepare:release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.generated.yml --win nsis --publish always
